code.description: Stable small integer id referenced by testCase.app / testRun.app.

platform.description: Platform the app targets (e.g. iOS, Android).

description.description: Optional description of the app under test.

app.description: An application under QA. testCases/testRuns reference it by the integer `code`. Lets the framework host plans for multiple apps.

code.description: Stable small integer id referenced by testCase.tier.

name.description: Frequency tier name: Essential, Common, Thorough, Uncommon, Manual, Unspecified.

tier.description: Lookup table of frequency tiers. testCase.tier holds the integer `code`.

code.description: Stable small integer id referenced by testCase.category.

name.description: Feature-area / Domain name (Core, Identity, DPNS, Token, Shielded, DashPay, System, ...). Modalities like multi-wallet / group are tags, not categories.

category.description: Lookup table of feature-area categories. testCase.category holds the integer `code`.

testId.description: Test identifier from the test plan (e.g. CORE-05). Unique per app.

app.description: App this test belongs to (foreign key -> app.code).

title.description: Human-readable action being tested (the plan's Action column).

layer.description: Stack layer: Core, Platform, Cross, Shielded.

description.description: Entry point & test notes for the action.

entryPoint.description: Primary code entry point (view / FFI function).

prerequisites.description: Fixtures/preconditions required before this test can run.

planCommit.description: git commit of the source plan this testCase was seeded from.

tags.description: Comma-separated cross-cutting labels orthogonal to category (e.g. "multiwallet,contested"). Drawn from the canonical TAGS vocabulary in src/codes.mjs; stored as a string because DPP document schemas only support byte arrays, not typed arrays. The dashboard splits on ',' and filters client-side.

testCase.description: A single test definition, mirroring one row of an app's test plan. Unique per (testId, app); tier/category/app are integer foreign keys into the lookup document types; tags are cross-cutting string labels. Mutable; owner-only creation (single QA-owner identity).

testId.description: Test identifier this run is a result for (matches testCase.testId within the same app).

app.description: App this run targets (foreign key -> app.code; pairs with testId).

result.description: Outcome. One of: pass, fail, blocked, skipped.

network.description: Network id the run executed against: 0=mainnet, 1=testnet, 2=devnet, 3=regtest.

buildRef.description: Build under test (commit SHA, branch+sha, or app build number).

device.description: Device / simulator the run executed on.

evidence.description: Pointer to evidence (txid, on-chain id, screenshot path, or URL).

testRun.description: An append-only record of one test execution for (app, testId). Immutable and non-deletable: an audit log. $createdAt is the run time. Owner-only creation in v1; relax creationRestrictionMode to 0 to let any identity submit runs.
